question: What lineage of transmission authorizes giving this teaching to the recipient?
premises: Viṣṇu gave this teaching to us.
I now transmit it to you.
The recipient is addressed as best of the twice-born.
inference: Given by Viṣṇu to us, it is given by me to you, O best of the twice-born.
plain_english: It was given by Viṣṇu to us, and by me to you, O best of the twice-born.
